verdict.rationale: The API surface is broad and API-first. It includes grounded answers with citations, a raw Search API, embeddings, an Agent API with web search, URL fetch and code-sandbox tools, structured output, multi-turn context, saved profiles, a CLI, an OpenAPI spec, and a hosted MCP server. A Computer MCP server also exposes browsing, code execution and document creation. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows feature parity with the Perplexity UI or console; the Playground only shows that search works the same in both places. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, API coverage of console and admin functions (keys, billing, projects), API equivalents of consumer-app features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
